content:
anna-peopleops: Quick heads-up — starting a handbook wording harmonization across PTO, parental leave, and expense policy. These are editorial clarifications and example expansions only; there are NO eligibility changes. Need manager acknowledgements + a 20-min compliance micro-training completed by 2026-04-12. Link to diff & sign: https://internal.redwood/handbook/diffs :memo:

devon-hr: Thanks! Do we have a final diff for managers to review? cc @sarah-peopleops

sarah-peopleops: Uploaded here: https://internal.redwood/handbook/diff-2026-04-01.pdf — highlights at the top. Also added a short FAQ for manager Qs.

sam-eng-manager: Quick Q — does this change accrual caps or carryover rules? I skimmed the diff and want to be sure before I forward to the team.

anna-peopleops: No changes to accrual caps or eligibility. We only clarified language and added examples of how carryover is applied. If any manager sees wording that could be construed as a policy change, please flag it here.

luis-ic: Can you add me to the manager ack list? I'm managing a new IC and want to confirm I sign off.

anna-peopleops: @luis-ic the manager list is autogenerated from People Ops LDAP by team lead role. I'll run an audit and post the CSV for verification.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled — 2-day pre-deadline nudge will go out on 2026-04-10. Training module: "Handbook Updates — What Managers Need" (20m). Link: https://training.redwood/handbook-2026

sarah-peopleops: Export command for the manager ack CSV (for the infra folks):
```
python scripts/export_managers.py --org=redwood --fields="name,email,team,manager_count" --since=2023-01-01 > manager_acks_2026-04.csv
```

sam-eng-manager: Got it, thanks. Also — can Ops get a copy of the sample manager message for cascading? Would like to drop into our standups.

anna-peopleops: Yes — using this template (please adapt as needed):
"Hey team — FYI we clarified handbook wording around PTO and expense reimbursements. No eligibility changes. Please complete the 20m micro-training by Apr 12: <training link>. Reach out to your manager if you have questions"

devon-hr: I'll run the CSV audit today and ping when it's uploaded.

sarah-peopleops: Done — CSV uploaded to /shared/hr/manager_acks_2026-04.csv (read-only).

luis-ic: Completed training ✅

sam-eng-manager: Acknowledged, I'll share the template in this week's team channel.

anna-peopleops: Thanks everyone — final ack tracker will be posted by EOD. Q&A drop-in scheduled for Thu 11am PT (calendar invite sent). :tada:
